job_desc:
I need a complete Shopify store built from the ground up to sell a line of physical products. The project starts with crafting a fully custom theme that reflects my brand’s personality and delivers a smooth shopping experience on desktop and mobile.



Beyond the visual design, I also want the store configured with:

• Customer reviews displayed on each product page and summarized site-wide

• A secure payment gateway set up and tested (Shopify Payments plus one additional method, phonepay , Razorpay etc)

• Inventory management configured so stock levels sync automatically and low-stock alerts fire without fail



I will supply product photos, copy, and brand guidelines. You’ll handle theme design, layout, app selection or custom code (if needed) for the three features above, and launch-ready testing. Please outline your approach, timeline, and any past Shopify builds that show similar custom work.

job_desc:
I want to launch a clean, fast-loading blog and pair it with a native Android companion app.



For the web side, the priority is a flexible CMS that lets me post articles, embed images and video, manage categories, and track basic analytics without digging into code every time. A modern, mobile-responsive theme and solid SEO foundations are essential; if you prefer WordPress, Gatsby, or another stack, let me know why it’s the right fit.



On Android I need an app that pulls the same content, displays posts neatly, allows offline reading of cached articles, and sends push notifications when a new piece goes live. I’m open to Kotlin, Flutter, or React Native—whichever you’re most confident will keep maintenance straightforward.



Deliverables

• Live blog website deployed on my chosen host and domain

• Source code and build of the Android app published to my Google Play console

• Brief hand-over guide covering content management and future updates



I’ll provide brand assets and initial copy as soon as we start. Let me know your preferred tech stack, timeline, and anything else you need to hit the ground running.

proposals.proposal:
Hi there,



Your project is a great fit for the type of systems we build at Lattice Teams.



Based on your requirements, I’d recommend WordPress for the blog (easy content management, SEO-friendly, scalable, and fast to maintain) and Native Android with Kotlin for the app (better performance, offline caching, and reliable push notifications).



What I’ll deliver:

Fully deployed blog website on your hosting/domain

Android app connected to blog content

Offline reading + push notifications

Google Play publishing support

Source code + handover guide



Estimated timeline: ~3–5 weeks depending on design and revision scope.



A few quick questions:

• Do you already have hosting/domain setup?

• Do you prefer a clean premium template or a more custom design?



Looking forward to discussing this further.

Hi, hope you're doing well! I'd love to help you launch your blog and Android app together as a cohesive product.



Here's my approach:



CMS and Blog: WordPress with a lightweight theme gives you full content control, SEO tools, and analytics without touching code.



Android App: Flutter is my pick here as it keeps maintenance simple and supports offline caching and push notifications cleanly.



Foundations: Fast load times, mobile-responsive design, and solid SEO baked in from day one.



Here's a similar project I built: https://octoro.co.uk/



A few questions to help me plan this properly:



1. Do you have a visual style or brand colors in mind, or would you like design suggestions?



2. How frequently do you plan to publish, and do you need any scheduling or draft workflow features?



3. For push notifications, should they trigger automatically on publish or go through a manual approval step?



Ready to get started whenever you are!
